item.title: School of Engineering Receives Transformational Naming Gift for ECSE | October 9 Campus Celebration
item.description: This week, the School of Engineering celebrated a $27 million donation to ECSE from Doug Mercer ’77. In recognition of his transformational generosity and long-term commitment to ECSE, the department will be renamed the Douglas A. Mercer ’77 Department of Electrical, Computer, and Systems Engineering. A formal ceremony will be held on October 9 at 9:00 AM at EMPAC.

item.title: Computer Science Colloquia - Keith Feldman - Representation, Structure, and Context: Developing Computational Frameworks for Real-World Health Data
item.description: Date: Tuesday, September 29, 2026 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM - The growing scale and scope of real-world health data offer new opportunities to advance our understanding of human health, yet their availability alone cannot ensure effective use. Diverse data collection practices often leave only a fragmented view of an individual and their care. In practice, these data are frequently reduced to only pieces. I will explore the development of computational approaches that more fully account for this…

item.title: Math Colloquium: Dr. David Persson from Flatiron Institute
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 30, 2026 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM - This Mathematical Sciences Colloquium will feature a presentation titled “The polar express: Optimal matrix sign methods and their application to the muon algorithm” by Dr. David Persson. He is a Courant Instructor at the Courant Institute and a Research Fellow at the Flatiron Institute. His research focuses on the design and analysis of numerical linear algebra algorithms.
